description: Unit test class for the ProjectTask module in SuiteCRM, using PHPUnit framework to test various methods including create_export_query, save, deletion, parent/child relationships, statistics, and ACLs.

classes.name: ProjectTaskTest
classes.description: PHPUnit test class extending SuitePHPUnitFrameworkTestCase for testing ProjectTask module functionalities.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Prepares testing environment, initializes current user.

methods.name: testcreate_export_query
methods.description: Tests the create_export_query method with empty and valid parameters.

methods.name: testProjectTask
methods.description: Verifies object instantiation and property values of ProjectTask bean.

methods.name: testsave
methods.description: Tests saving a ProjectTask record and deletion functionality.

methods.name: _get_depends_on_name
methods.description: Verifies the _get_depends_on_name method returns expected name for a given ID.

methods.name: testgetProjectTaskParent
methods.description: Checks behavior of getProjectTaskParent when parent_task_id is set.

methods.name: testupdateStatistic
methods.description: Ensures updateStatistic method executes without errors.

methods.name: testfill_in_additional_detail_fields
methods.description: Tests fill_in_additional_detail_fields with and without assigned_user_id.

methods.name: testget_summary_text
methods.description: Checks get_summary_text behavior with and without name set.

methods.name: test_get_project_name
methods.description: Tests _get_project_name with empty and invalid IDs.

methods.name: test_get_parent_name
methods.description: Tests _get_parent_name with empty and invalid IDs.

methods.name: testbuild_generic_where_clause
methods.description: Verifies build_generic_where_clause with different input strings.

methods.name: testbean_implements
methods.description: Checks bean_implements returns correct values for empty, invalid, and ACL.

methods.name: testlistviewACLHelper
methods.description: Validates listviewACLHelper returns expected permissions array.

methods.name: testgetUtilizationDropdown
methods.description: Verifies the dropdown HTML for utilization values.
